body.purpose: Vietnamese work content; Apple-first installed font stack.

shadows.name: field-focus

motion.name: control-transition

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Blue primary action, minimum 44px height and explicit keyboard outline.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 18px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:var(--color-action,#0066cc);color:#fff;font-family:var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Display','SF Pro Text','Inter','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,box-shadow 160ms ease-out}.ds-primary:hover{background:#0055ad}.ds-primary:focus-visible{border-color:#0ea5e9;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(14 165 233 / 15%);outline:2px solid var(--color-action,#0066cc);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral secondary action used beside the result workflow.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-secondary">Xử lý / Sửa kết quả</button>
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:var(--color-canvas,#f5f5f7);color:var(--color-ink,#1d1d1f);font-family:var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Display','SF Pro Text','Inter','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,box-shadow 160ms ease-out}.ds-secondary:hover{background:#e9e9ed}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{border-color:#0ea5e9;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(14 165 233 / 15%);outline:2px solid var(--color-action,#0066cc);outline-offset:3px}.ds-secondary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

components.name: Board Search
components.description: Phone search for board, accent-insensitive player name or explicit STT.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg class="ds-search-icon" aria-hidden="true" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input class="ds-search-field" type="search" inputmode="search" aria-label="Tìm bàn đấu" placeholder="Số bàn hoặc tên kỳ thủ"/></label>
components.css: .ds-search{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;max-width:390px}.ds-search-icon{position:absolute;top:50%;left:12px;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--color-muted,#62626a);pointer-events:none}.ds-search-field{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;height:48px;padding:0 12px 0 40px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:4px;background:var(--color-canvas,#f5f5f7);color:var(--color-ink,#1d1d1f);font-family:var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Display','SF Pro Text','Inter','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif);font-size:16px;accent-color:var(--color-action,#0066cc);caret-color:var(--color-action,#0066cc)}.ds-search-field::placeholder{color:#73737b}.ds-search-field:focus{outline:none;border-color:#0ea5e9;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(14 165 233 / 15%)}.ds-search-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-action,#0066cc);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Results/publication versus settings/import; selected state uses aria-pressed.
components.css: .ds-workspace{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;padding:4px;width:fit-content;max-width:100%;border-radius:4px;background:#eaeaee}.ds-workspace-item{min-height:44px;padding:10px 18px;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:var(--color-muted,#62626a);font-family:var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Display','SF Pro Text','Inter','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,box-shadow 160ms ease-out}.ds-workspace-item[aria-pressed=true]{background:#fff;color:var(--color-ink,#1d1d1f);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 7%)}.ds-workspace-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-action,#0066cc);outline-offset:3px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(14 165 233 / 15%)}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-workspace{width:100%}.ds-workspace-item{flex:1;padding-inline:8px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-workspace-item{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

narrative.overview:
This records the user's pinned direction and the shipped implementation, not a new brand concept. A fixed light canvas, white work surfaces, graphite text and restrained blue actions keep Vietnamese names, boards and results readable in a bright tournament hall. Tournament logos and colors remain user-configured identity, not a replacement application palette.

The interface prioritizes correct-board operation and safe confirmation over decoration. Preserve the current copy, role boundaries, offline feedback and result workflow when extending it. Existing dark/semantic-color kiosk steps distinguish players and confirmation outcomes; they are functional exceptions within the light application, not an alternate theme.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed Apple-light application chrome with system typography.
Small corners, soft separators and nearly flat white surfaces.
Data-first density, explicit status text and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Official-Only Rule
rules.body: On the projector, show a score only for OFFICIAL; otherwise show the existing pending-state text. Never use color to imply a result is already published.

dos: Do retain the fixed light application, Apple-first font stack and blue-primary/gray-secondary action hierarchy.
Do keep written statuses, board/STT distinctions, confirmation steps and offline/sync feedback.
Do preserve keyboard outlines, responsive wrapping and the default 40-board/two-column projector overview.
Do honor saved projector settings and use only supplied tournament identity assets.
donts: Don't introduce black borders, decorative gradients, large rounded cards or marketing imagery.
Don't publish provisional scores, calculate standings from imported points or remove safety steps to simplify a screen.
Don't treat intentional dense-name truncation as permission to clip scores, board numbers or the projector footer.
Don't replace the current copy, brand assets, API, roles or persistence model as a styling change.
